question: Which divine figures receive salutation as charioteer, unharming one, and lord of forests?
premises: The charioteer and an unharming figure are addressed.
A lord of the forests is addressed.
inference: The verse offers repeated homage to the charioteer, the unharming one, and the lord of the forests.
uncertainties: The epithet ahantyai is morphologically unusual in this context and may reflect a textual form requiring tradition-specific interpretation.
plain_english: Salutation, salutation to the charioteer, to the unharming one; salutation, salutation to the lord of the forests.
